note: One workload_dependency edge from the family's positive pair: repo-ifa-workload-dependency-source depends on repo-ifa-workload-dependency-target (Docker Compose depends_on evidence), and both own exactly one current-generation Kubernetes-Deployment workload, so ReconcileWorkloadDependencyEdges admits workload:workload-dependency-source -> workload:workload-dependency-target.
